title: nan
authors: Wang C.-L.; Wang T.-M.; Liang J.-H.; Zhang Y.-C.; Zhou Y.
key_contribution: Presents a hierarchical visual SLAM framework using monocular homography motion estimation fused with IMU via indirect EKF for small UAVs in GPS-denied environments.

methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
